faq: Will my live store change while you work?
No. We edit a copy of the theme and show you a preview. Nothing goes live until you say so, and your original theme stays saved so you can switch back if you wish.
Can you edit a theme I bought from someone else?
Yes, as long as it is a Stencil theme and you have the right to change it. If the theme vendor limits edits, we tell you before we start and suggest the closest option.
Do you fix problems caused by apps?
We can find out whether an app script is breaking your theme and remove or adjust the clash. Changes to the app itself are up to its maker.
What do you need from me?
Collaborator access to your store, a list of the changes you want, and screenshots or page links where something looks wrong. The more specific you are, the faster we move.
desc:
BigCommerce Stencil theme edits fix what looks wrong and change what you want different in your storefront. Ecom Swift LLC works on a safe copy of your theme, shows you a preview, and applies the finished changes only after you approve.

## What are BigCommerce Stencil theme edits?

Stencil is the theme framework BigCommerce stores use for their storefront. Theme edits are changes to that code and its templates: layout fixes, a new page template, a changed header, a broken filter or a mobile bug. They go beyond what the visual theme editor allows.

The edits are made in a copy of your theme, tested there, and then applied. That way, the store customers see is not disturbed while the work is in progress.

## Why small theme problems deserve attention

A misaligned button or a menu that fails on one phone looks minor. To a shopper, it looks like a store nobody maintains. A filter that returns nothing, a product image that overflows the screen or a checkout link that sits behind a banner can stop a purchase outright.

Because themes combine templates, styles and scripts, a quick patch can break something elsewhere. Careful edits, tested on both mobile and desktop and in more than one browser, prevent the fix from creating a new problem.

## How theme edits improve the store

Fixes remove obstacles. When the add to cart button works everywhere and the menu is easy to use, shoppers finish what they started. Layout changes help important products and categories stand out. A new template can give a landing page or collection its own purpose-built look.

Cleaning up leftover code also helps. Old scripts and unused sections add weight to pages, and removing them can make the storefront lighter. We describe what each edit improves, but we cannot promise a particular sales result, since that also depends on products and traffic.

## What good theme work includes

- Work done on a theme copy, never on the live theme.
- Layout fixes for spacing, alignment, images and text.
- Header and footer changes, including menus and links.
- New page templates for categories, landing pages or content.
- Fixes for bugs such as broken filters, sliders and mobile menus.
- Custom sections in the larger packages.
- A custom product page layout where needed.
- Checks on desktop, mobile and across browsers.
- A preview link for your review.
- A change list in plain English, with notes for the next person who edits the theme.

## How we work

You tell us what is wrong or what you want changed, ideally with screenshots or page addresses. We review the theme and confirm what the work will involve, including anything caused by an app instead of the theme itself.

We then make the edits on a copy of your Stencil theme using the BigCommerce theme tools, test them, and send a preview link. After you approve, we apply the finished theme. The Basic package covers a few small edits. Standard handles more edits and fixes, one new template and a header or footer rework. Premium covers a bigger upgrade with custom sections, a custom product layout and a template and script cleanup.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send screenshots and the exact page address for each problem.
- Say which device and browser shows the issue.
- Tell us about any recent app installs or theme updates.
- Review the preview on your phone as well as a computer.
- Keep the change list for your records.

**Avoid:**
- Editing the live theme directly while we work on a copy.
- Pasting random code snippets from forums.
- Stacking several apps that all change the same page area.
- Approving changes without testing mobile.
- Leaving old theme copies cluttering the account.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner whose theme has a visible bug, a brand that wants a new template for a campaign or collection, and a seller using a theme bought from someone else who needs a developer to adapt it.

## What we need from you

A clear description of each change or fix, with screenshots, and the name of the theme you use. We never need your password. You add us as a staff user or developer with theme permissions, and your live store stays as it is until you approve the preview.
